_comment: Ledger for keeping Parlance (this repo) and Hebrish (Hebrish-ASR/Hebrish-App, local ~/repos/github/audio-dictation/Hebrish-Dictation) level. Each *_through is the last commit of that repo already reviewed for porting to the other: everything after it is unreviewed. Updated by the asr-dev plugin's sync-hebrish-to-parlance / sync-parlance-to-hebrish skills in the same commit as the port. 'skipped' lists commits reviewed and deliberately not ported, with the reason. What differs on purpose: android/docs/maintaining.md, 'Twin of Hebrish'.

skipped.why: Hebrish-only: removes the tech and personal fine-tunes from Hebrish's catalogue
Hebrish CDN download links and hebrish.app release steps; Parlance releases on GitHub

baseline: 2026-10-20: Parlance Android 0.4.0/0.5.0 = Hebrish Android 0.4.0/0.5.0 (tree ported file for file, 349cd2f/d21544c + 9231c08 from Hebrish 520b1ae); Parlance desktop 0.3.0 has Hebrish desktop 0.2.2's CDN manifest_url and v1.0 About numbers. Parlance had nothing Hebrish lacked.
